method: directed dependency graph over the documented assembly steps
assembly_order: load the steel ballast, close the cartridge lid
fit the active-driver gasket and driver, install the clamp ring
fit both radiator gaskets and radiators, install both clamp rings
route the speaker pair through the divider and fit the TPU gland
fit the divider gasket and bolt the pressure divider to the cabinet
bolt the base skirt up into the acoustic floor
lower the outer shell over the cabinet
seat the ballast cartridge and close the bottom service plate
connect the boards and bolt the electronics shroud to the divider
invert and bolt the outer shell to the bottom service plate
seat the official mid-plate and upper stack on the divider bosses
stretch the TPU anti-slip ring onto the base
disassembly_order: stretch the TPU anti-slip ring onto the base
seat the official mid-plate and upper stack on the divider bosses
invert and bolt the outer shell to the bottom service plate
connect the boards and bolt the electronics shroud to the divider
seat the ballast cartridge and close the bottom service plate
lower the outer shell over the cabinet
bolt the base skirt up into the acoustic floor
fit the divider gasket and bolt the pressure divider to the cabinet
route the speaker pair through the divider and fit the TPU gland
fit both radiator gaskets and radiators, install both clamp rings
fit the active-driver gasket and driver, install the clamp ring
load the steel ballast, close the cartridge lid

service_tasks.task: replace a passive radiator or retune its added mass

trapped_part_check.note: Every part is removed along the reverse of its insertion direction with no other part obstructing that direction; the graph has a single source and no cycles.

physical_gate.requirement: Perform one full assembly and disassembly on printed parts.
